name: quick-chat
description: Real-time chat application built with MongoDB, Express, React, Redux and Socket.IO
author: Agni Roybar

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm run test:ci --prefix client
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec server npm run seed
scripts.docker:test: docker compose run --rm server sh -c "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm test && npm run test:e2e"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
